headline: Smart drugs,
thin proof.
dek: Brain covers 16 treatments, from FDA-approved Spravato to P21, which has never been tested in people.
byline: Adonis Men’s Health · Checked Nov 1, 2026 · Clinical review pending

glance.label: Approved for the brain
glance.line: Spravato for depression, under a REMS; Provigil for wakefulness. Focus is not an approved use.

glance.label: No human studies
glance.line: P21 and dihexa: no published study in people.

glance.label: Banned in sport
glance.line: Modafinil is named under S6.A and banned in competition.

summary: The Brain lane holds 16 treatments sold to men for focus, memory or mood, and few of them are approved for any of that. [[/esketamine|Esketamine]] is: FDA approved it as Spravato in 2019 for treatment-resistant depression, with a boxed warning, and it is available only through a restricted program, the SPRAVATO REMS. [[/modafinil|Modafinil]] is approved to improve wakefulness in narcolepsy, sleep apnea and shift work disorder; using it, or [[/armodafinil|armodafinil]], for focus is off-label. [[/ketamine|Ketamine]] is approved as an anesthetic, so its use for depression is off-label, and [[/methylene-blue|methylene blue]] is approved only as an intravenous antidote.

Several have never been tested in people. [[/p21|P21]], built from part of a nerve-growth protein called CNTF, has been studied only in mice and rats. FDA says it has not identified any human exposure data for [[/dihexa|dihexa]], and in April 2025 a journal retracted the main paper on how dihexa acts, along with two related papers. Others come from Russia or Europe with small studies: [[/semax|Semax]], [[/selank|Selank]], [[/noopept|Noopept]] and [[/pinealon|Pinealon]], and [[/cerebrolysin|Cerebrolysin]], approved in Austria. None of them is FDA approved, and neither is [[/piracetam|piracetam]], a licensed medicine in the UK. [[/alpha-gpc|Alpha-GPC]] is sold in the US as a supplement.

Two are marketed for mood under very different laws. [[/psilocybin|Psilocybin]] is a Schedule I controlled substance under federal law and is in Phase 3 trials for depression; Oregon and Colorado license psilocybin services under state law. FDA says [[/kratom|kratom]] is not lawfully marketed in the US as a drug, a dietary supplement or a food ingredient, and DEA has proposed to schedule the related compound 7-OH above a set level.

What is not known: whether any of these sharpens focus or memory in healthy men, and what long-term use of the research-only compounds does. For P21 and dihexa, nothing has been measured in people at all.

pull.quote: FDA lacks important information regarding any safety issues raised by dihexa acetate, including whether it would cause harm if administered to humans

excerpts.quote: Risk for sedation, dissociation, and respiratory depression after administration. Monitor patients for at least two hours after administration. … SPRAVATO is only available through a restricted program called the SPRAVATO REMS.
excerpts.note: A REMS is an FDA-required safety program that limits how a drug is given.

excerpts.quote: PROVIGIL is indicated to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness associated with narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), or shift work disorder (SWD).
excerpts.note: Focus, studying and general fatigue are not on the list.

excerpts.quote: Ketamine administration is associated with hepatobiliary dysfunction (most often a cholestatic pattern), with recurrent use (e.g., misuse/abuse or medically supervised unapproved indications).
excerpts.note: Hepatobiliary means the liver and bile ducts.

excerpts.quote: FDA has not identified any human exposure data on drug products containing dihexa acetate administered via any route of administration.
excerpts.source: FDA, Category 2 page (bulk drug substances that may present significant safety risks)
excerpts.note: Dihexa is listed among nominations that were later withdrawn.

excerpts.quote: Therefore, kratom is not lawfully marketed in the U.S. as a drug product, a dietary supplement, or a food additive in conventional food.
Retraction notice to "The Procognitive and Synaptogenic Effects of Angiotensin IV-Derived Peptides Are Dependent on Activation of the Hepatocyte Growth Factor/c-Met System"
excerpts.source: J Pharmacol Exp Ther, retraction notice
excerpts.note: This 2014 paper described how dihexa acts. The notice gives no reason in its PubMed record.

excerpts.quote: Availability of appropriate neurotrophic support during the period of synaptic compensation can prevent synaptic deficit and cognitive impairment, and P021 is a promising neurotrophic compound for this purpose.
excerpts.source: Baazaoui and Iqbal, Alzheimers Res Ther, 2017
excerpts.note: This was a mouse study. P21 has not been given to people.
